note: Shoshone NF (Greybull RD) campground up the Greybull River west of Meeteetse: WY-290 west, the pavement ending after about 11 miles, then gravel to the campground and trailhead. An open loop on the sagebrush above the river, which runs behind a band of aspen and cottonwood. Livestock are kept out of the campground; stock trailers park at the trailhead (corrals, hitch rails) or the horse camping area. No garbage collection and no cell service. --Claude
